detail.summary: Following the squirrel directive to enforce the 'dance' topic, I have parked existing epistemology work and initiated a new project to investigate the cognitive and social dimensions of rhythm and movement in dance. The goal is to establish a source-backed baseline for understanding how these elements influence the perception of dance.
